screened_out.reason: Franchises and franchise resales are out of scope (e.g. Baskin-Robbins, Cold Stone Creamery, Bonchon, Papa John's, Round Table Pizza). Mail centers and 'branded' boba shops should be checked, as some are franchises.

notes: Ranking: payback (asking / cash flow) 40%, cash-flow margin 20%, earnings size 15%, lease/rent risk 15%, info quality 10%. Weights are editable on the Criteria sheet.
Cash flow is the seller's claimed SDE (owner's earnings before debt). Verify with tax returns and bank statements.
Listings from BizBen (plus one BizBuySell). BizBuySell and BizQuest mostly blocked automated reading and BizBen category pages were only partly read, so this is a sample, not a full sweep.
